newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Elec develops network computer.
newsitem.headline: LG Elec develops network computer.

text.p: South Korea's LG Electronics Inc said on Friday it had developed a network computer that would retail for about a quarter of the price of regular personal computers.
LG, a unit of the LG Group, said in a statement it planned to begin domestic and overseas sales of the LG Java Computers from March for around $600-$700.
A network computer has no storage device such as hard or floppy disk drives and uses programmes over the Internet.
The LG Java Computer will be unveiled at the Comdex Fall '96 show in Las Vegas next week, the statement said.
